# Ge Yu (余舸)

> Personal academic website of Ge Yu, Ph.D. Candidate in Finance at the Swedish House of Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (Stockholm, Sweden). Research interests: asset management, machine learning and AI, empirical asset pricing, and FinTech. On the academic job market in 2026–2027.

Contact: ge.yu@hhs.se · Office 671/674, Sveavägen 65, 113 50 Stockholm, Sweden

## Research

- Job market paper: "From Words to Portfolios: Disentangling Narrative and Reality in Mutual Fund Differentiation" — combines a transformer-based portfolio embedding model with large language model embeddings of fund prospectuses to construct two measures of mutual fund differentiation (portfolio holdings vs. prospectus narratives); the two are only weakly correlated, and the findings suggest narrative differentiation serves a marketing and pricing role, while portfolio uniqueness predicts future alpha only among funds with a strong track record. Latest draft: https://geyu.me/jmp/
- Work in progress: "The Law of One Plot: Price Charts, Social Media Sentiment, and Flows" (with Riccardo Sabbatucci)
- Work in progress: "Generative AI and the Bundling of Work Requirements" (with Tianxian Zheng and Haofeng Zhou)
- Working paper: "Investor Beliefs in the Age of AI: Evidence from Prediction Markets"

## Education

- Ph.D. in Finance, Stockholm School of Economics (2021–present)
- M.S. in Applied Economics and Management, Cornell University (2019–2021)
- B.A. in Public Finance, Central University of Finance and Economics (2015–2019)
